stories.title: Na 44 jaar definitieve straf voor moord op Nederlandse journalisten in El Salvador

en.title: After 44 years, final conviction for murder of Dutch journalists in El Salvador
en.summary: Three military leaders convicted of killing four Dutch journalists in El Salvador in 1982 have had their appeal rejected and will serve thirty years in prison, concluding the case after 44 years.

stories.title: Widow's Bay domineert Emmy's met veertien prijzen, The Pitt beste dramaserie

en.title: Widow's Bay dominates Emmy Awards with fourteen prizes, The Pitt best drama series
en.summary: Widow's Bay won fourteen Emmy Awards, setting a record for a comedy series, while The Pitt won best drama series for the second consecutive year.

stories.title: Grote treinstoring door sabotageactie: buizen vastgemaakt aan spoor

en.title: Major train disruption caused by sabotage: tubes attached to tracks
en.summary: Train services across large parts of the Netherlands were disrupted due to materials deliberately placed on multiple track sections, which authorities suspect is sabotage.

stories.title: Grote spoorstoring als gevolg van sabotage: buizen aan spoor vastgemaakt

en.title: Major rail disruption resulting from sabotage: tubes attached to tracks
en.summary: Train traffic in part of the Netherlands was disrupted due to suspected sabotage involving material placed at multiple locations on tracks in central Netherlands.

stories.title: Veroordelingen voor moord op Nederlandse IKON-journalisten blijven staan

en.title: Convictions for murder of Dutch IKON journalists upheld
en.summary: Convictions for the killing of four Dutch journalists from broadcaster IKON in El Salvador have been upheld after an appeal by three military officials was rejected.

stories.title: ‘The Pitt’ wint voor tweede jaar op rij Emmy voor beste dramaserie

en.title: 'The Pitt' wins Emmy for best drama series for second consecutive year
en.summary: The Pitt has won the Emmy Award for best drama series for the second year in a row.

stories.title: Roedel wilde honden in Zambia legt 4000 kilometer af in zoektocht naar partner

en.title: Pack of wild dogs in Zambia travels 4000 kilometers in search of partner
en.summary: African wild dogs traveled 4000 kilometers through Zambia in search of a mate, setting a record for the greatest distance traveled by an African land animal on such a quest, according to scientists who tracked them with GPS devices.

stories.title: Hooggerechtshof VS: regering mag geen strengere regels voor poststemmen invoeren

en.title: US Supreme Court: government cannot implement stricter mail-in voting rules
en.summary: The US Supreme Court refused to block a lower court's decision preventing the Trump administration from implementing stricter rules for mail-in voting. A Boston judge had already halted the stricter regulations.

stories.title: Veroordeling voor moord op Ikon-journalisten blijft staan, hoger beroep verworpen

en.title: Conviction for murder of IKON journalists remains upheld, appeal rejected
en.summary: The conviction in the case of murdered IKON journalists remains in effect after an appeal was rejected.

stories.title: Inzittenden van in Duitsland neergestort vliegtuigje waren drie Nederlanders

en.title: Occupants of aircraft crashed in Germany were three Dutch nationals
en.summary: Three Dutch citizens died when a small aircraft departed from Hilversum and crashed near the German town of Erkelenz. The victims were two men aged 57 and 58, and a 23-year-old woman.

stories.title: Alle drie inzittenden van neergestort vliegtuigje in Duitsland waren Nederlanders

en.title: All three occupants of aircraft that crashed in Germany were Dutch nationals
en.summary: All three people who died in the crash of an aircraft in Germany were Dutch nationals. The aircraft departed from Vliegschool Hilversum and crashed just across the German border.

stories.title: Drie Nederlanders overleden na crash met Hilversums vliegtuigje net over de Duitse grens

en.title: Three Dutch people died after crash involving Hilversum aircraft just over German border
en.summary: A Cessna 172 aircraft from Hilversum flight school crashed just across the German border, resulting in three Dutch fatalities. The aircraft was completely destroyed upon impact.
